en.headline: Customs seizes 5.4 kg of cannabis buds at airport, two men charged
en.dek: Hong Kong Customs arrested two mainland passengers arriving from Vietnam and Thailand and seized suspected cannabis buds valued at about HK$1.1 million.
body: Hong Kong Customs said it detected a drug trafficking case involving incoming air passengers at Hong Kong International Airport on Friday and seized about 5.4 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of about HK$1.1 million.

A 58-year-old mainland male passenger who arrived from Phu Quoc in Vietnam was found carrying the suspected cannabis buds in his carry-on suitcase during clearance. After further investigation, officers arrested a 36-year-old mainland male passenger who arrived the same day from Bangkok, Thailand, and was suspected to be connected with the case.
The two men have been jointly charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug. The case is scheduled to be brought up at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Saturday.

Customs said it would continue to step up enforcement against drug trafficking through intelligence analysis and apply a risk-based approach focusing on passengers from high-risk regions. Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, the maximum penalty upon conviction for trafficking is a fine of HK$5 million and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢5.4公斤大麻花 兩男同控販毒
zh.dek: 香港海關在機場拘捕兩名分別從越南及泰國抵港的內地男旅客，檢獲估計市值約110萬元的懷疑大麻花。
body: 香港海關表示，周五在香港國際機場偵破一宗涉及入境航空旅客的販毒案件，檢獲約5.4公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約110萬港元。
一名58歲內地男旅客從越南富國島抵港，海關人員在其手提行李箱內發現該批懷疑大麻花並將他拘捕。經調查後，人員再拘捕一名同日從泰國曼谷抵港、涉嫌與案件有關的36歲內地男旅客。
兩名男子已被共同控以一項販運危險藥物罪，案件將於周六在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關表示會繼續透過情報分析加強打擊販毒活動，並以風險為本原則重點檢查來自高風險地區的旅客。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物一經定罪最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
